'''Disasters and accidents'''

**A [[Russian Air Force]] [[Mil Mi-8T]] helicopter [[plane crash|crashes]] over the [[Russia|Russian]] [[Kamchatka Peninsula]] with all 22 personnel onboard killed. [https://apnews.com/article/helicopter-missing-russia-kamchatka-1d9794dc00e57f148119fd9eebd5cfbb (AP)]

**The death toll from the effects of [[Typhoon Shanshan (2024)|Typhoon Shanshan]] in [[Japan]] increases to six, with over 100 people injured. [https://www.reuters.com/world/japan/least-6-dead-japan-typhoon-shanshan-grinds-2024-08-31/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Yemen floods]]
**The death toll from [[flood]]ing in [[Al Mahwit Governorate]], [[Yemen]], increases to at least 97 people. [https://www.dw.com/en/yemen-floods-kill-nearly-100-and-damage-scores-of-homes/a-70098987 (DW)]
*Seven people are killed and dozens of others are injured in a bus crash near [[Vicksburg, Mississippi|Vicksburg]], [[Mississippi]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/mississippi-bus-crash-overturn-dead-injured-warren-county/ (CBS News)]
*Three people are killed and two more injured after a [[Cessna 421 Golden Eagle|Cessna 421C]] crashes in a row of [[townhouse]]s near [[Portland–Troutdale Airport|Troutdale Airport]] in [[Troutdale, Oregon|Troutdale]], [[Oregon]], United States.
